int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

class Peak(int moment, int position, int peak_i, int peak_f, int slope)
    thr_i := 0
    thr_f := 0
    category := ""

Peak[] find_peaks(int[][] signals)
    integrated := signals[4]
    band := signals[1]
    derivative := signals[2]
    count := int(#integrated)
    Peak[] result := []
    for: moment < count
        value := integrated[moment]
        valid := value > 0
        for: (if moment < 20 then 0 else moment - 20) <= index < moment
            if integrated[index] >= value
                valid = false
        for: moment + 1 <= index <= (if moment + 20 < count then moment + 20 else count - 1)
            if integrated[index] > value
                valid = false
        if not valid
            continue
        position := if moment < 30 then 0 else moment - 30
        for: position + 1 <= index <= moment
            if absolute(band[index]) > absolute(band[position])
                position = index
        slope := 0
        for: (if moment < 29 then 0 else moment - 29) <= index <= moment
            if absolute(derivative[index]) > slope
                slope = absolute(derivative[index])
        result = result.append(Peak(moment, position, value, absolute(band[position]), slope))
    return result

int[] initial_levels(int[][] signals)
    total_i := 0
    total_f := 0
    maximum_i := 0
    maximum_f := 0
    for: index < 400
        integrated := signals[4][index]
        band := absolute(signals[1][index])
        total_i += integrated
        total_f += band
        if integrated > maximum_i
            maximum_i = integrated
        if band > maximum_f
            maximum_f = band
    return [maximum_i / 3, total_i / 800, maximum_f / 3, total_f / 800]

int width(int[] band, int position)
    peak := absolute(band[position])
    first := -1
    last := -1
    for: (if position < 25 then 0 else position - 25) <= sample <= (if position + 25 < int(#band) then position + 25 else int(#band) - 1)
        if 4 * absolute(band[sample]) >= peak
            if first < 0
                first = sample
            last = sample
    return 5 * (last - first + 1)

import report = "./report.qui"

int at(int[] values, int sample)
    return if sample < 0 then 0 else values[sample]

int[][] run(int[] samples)
    int[] cumulative := []
    int[] moving := []
    int[] low := []
    int[] band := []
    int[] derivative := []
    int[] squared := []
    int[] integrated := []
    window := 0
    for: index < int(#samples)
        cumulative = cumulative.append(2 * at(cumulative, index - 1) - at(cumulative, index - 2) + samples[index] - 2 * at(samples, index - 6) + at(samples, index - 12))
        low = low.append(report.floor_div(cumulative[index], 32))
        moving = moving.append(at(moving, index - 1) + low[index] - at(low, index - 32))
        band = band.append(at(low, index - 16) - report.floor_div(moving[index], 32))
        derivative = derivative.append(report.floor_div(2 * band[index] + at(band, index - 1) - at(band, index - 3) - 2 * at(band, index - 4), 8))
        squared = squared.append(derivative[index] * derivative[index])
        window += squared[index] - at(squared, index - 30)
        integrated = integrated.append(window / 30)
    return [low, band, derivative, squared, integrated]

import report = "./report.qui"

int sum_values(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

int sum_squares(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value * value
    return result

int root(int numerator, int denominator)
    value := 40000 * numerator / denominator
    low := 0
    high := 1
    while high * high <= value
        high *= 2
    while high - low > 1
        middle := (low + high) / 2
        if middle * middle <= value
            low = middle
        else
            high = middle
    return (low + 1) / 2

class Statistics()
    mean_rr := -1
    mean_hr := -1
    shortest := -1
    longest := -1
    mean_nn := -1
    sdnn := -1
    rmssd := -1
    sdsd := -1
    nn50 := 0
    pnn50 := -1
    sd1 := -1
    sd2 := -1
    int[][] histogram := []
    histogram_max := 0
    triangular_index := -1

Statistics statistics(int[] rr, int[] nn, int[][] pairs)
    result := Statistics()
    count := int(#rr)
    amount := int(#nn)
    pair_count := int(#pairs)
    if count > 0
        result.mean_rr = report.rdiv(100 * sum_values(rr), count)
        result.mean_hr = report.rdiv(6000000 * count, sum_values(rr))
        result.shortest = 0
        result.longest = 0
        for: 1 <= index < count
            if rr[index] < rr[result.shortest]
                result.shortest = index
            if rr[index] > rr[result.longest]
                result.longest = index
    if amount > 0
        result.mean_nn = report.rdiv(100 * sum_values(nn), amount)
    if amount >= 2
        total := sum_values(nn)
        result.sdnn = root(amount * sum_squares(nn) - total * total, amount * (amount - 1))
    int[] differences := []
    int[] totals := []
    for pair := pairs[]
        difference := pair[1] - pair[0]
        differences = differences.append(difference)
        totals = totals.append(pair[0] + pair[1])
        if difference > 50 or difference < -50
            result.nn50 += 1
    if pair_count > 0
        result.rmssd = root(sum_squares(differences), pair_count)
        result.pnn50 = report.rdiv(10000 * result.nn50, pair_count)
    if pair_count >= 2
        total := sum_values(differences)
        numerator := pair_count * sum_squares(differences) - total * total
        result.sdsd = root(numerator, pair_count * (pair_count - 1))
        result.sd1 = root(numerator, 2 * pair_count * (pair_count - 1))
        total = sum_values(totals)
        result.sd2 = root(pair_count * sum_squares(totals) - total * total, 2 * pair_count * (pair_count - 1))
    bins := [for value := nn[] then 16 * value / 125]
    bins = bins.sorted()
    for bucket := bins[]
        place := int(#result.histogram) - 1
        if place >= 0 and result.histogram[place][0] == bucket
            result.histogram[place][1] += 1
        else
            result.histogram = result.histogram.append([bucket, 1])
            place += 1
        if result.histogram[place][1] > result.histogram_max
            result.histogram_max = result.histogram[place][1]
    if amount > 0
        result.triangular_index = report.rdiv(100 * amount, result.histogram_max)
    return result

int[][] ranges(int[] indices)
    int[][] result := []
    for index := indices[]
        last := int(#result) - 1
        if last >= 0 and index == result[last][1] + 1
            result[last][1] = index
        else
            result = result.append([index, index])
    return result

import report = "./report.qui"

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int minimum(int[] values)
    result := values[0]
    for value := values[]
        if value < result
            result = value
    return result

int maximum(int[] values)
    result := values[0]
    for value := values[]
        if value > result
            result = value
    return result

string pad(string value, int width)
    return " " * nat(if int(#value) < width then width - int(#value) else 0) + value

string yes(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

class Params(int[] values)
    refractory := values[0] / 5
    twave := values[1] / 5
    searchback_percent := values[2]
    premature_percent := values[3]
    qrs_width_ms := values[4]
    match_ms := values[5]
    pause_ms := values[6]
    brady_ms := values[7]
    tachy_ms := values[8]
    excerpt_ms := values[9]
    segment_ms := values[10]
    strip_start_ms := values[11]
    strip_ms := values[12]
    strip_rows := values[13]
    chart_rows := values[14]
    poincare_size := values[15]

int[] thresholds(int[] levels)
    integrated := levels[1] + report.floor_div(levels[0] - levels[1], 4)
    band := levels[3] + report.floor_div(levels[2] - levels[3], 4)
    return [integrated, band, report.floor_div(integrated, 2), report.floor_div(band, 2)]

class Detection(detector.Peak[] peaks, int[] initial, int[] config)
    levels := initial
    int[] registered := []
    int[] intervals := []
    ra1 := 200
    ra2 := 200

    void .register_peak(int index)
        if #registered > 0
            elapsed := peaks[index].moment - peaks[registered[-1]].moment
            intervals = intervals.append(elapsed)
            if #intervals > 8
                intervals = intervals[1:<int(#intervals)]
            ra1 = hrv.sum_values(intervals) / int(#intervals)
            if 92 * ra1 <= 100 * elapsed and 100 * elapsed <= 116 * ra1
                ra2 = ra1
        registered = registered.append(index)

    void .update_levels(int index, string kind)
        peak := peaks[index]
        if kind == "noise"
            levels[1] = (peak.peak_i + 7 * levels[1]) / 8
            levels[3] = (peak.peak_f + 7 * levels[3]) / 8
        else
            factor := if kind == "signal" then 7 else 3
            divisor := factor + 1
            levels[0] = (peak.peak_i + factor * levels[0]) / divisor
            levels[2] = (peak.peak_f + factor * levels[2]) / divisor

    void .search_back(int moment)
        while true
            last := if #registered > 0 then peaks[registered[-1]].moment else 0
            if moment - last <= ra2 * config[2] / 100
                break
            current := thresholds(levels)
            chosen := -1
            for: index < int(#peaks)
                peak := peaks[index]
                if peak.category == "noise" and peak.moment > last and peak.moment < moment and peak.peak_i > current[2] and peak.peak_f > current[3] and (chosen < 0 or peak.peak_i > peaks[chosen].peak_i)
                    chosen = index
            if chosen < 0
                break
            .update_levels(chosen, "searchback")
            peaks[chosen].category = "searchback"
            .register_peak(chosen)

    void .run(int count)
        for: index < int(#peaks)
            .search_back(peaks[index].moment)
            current := thresholds(levels)
            peak := peaks[index]
            peak.thr_i = current[0]
            peak.thr_f = current[1]
            last := if #registered > 0 then registered[-1] else -1
            update := ""
            register := false
            if last >= 0 and peak.moment - peaks[last].moment < config[0] / 5
                peak.category = "refractory"
            elif peak.peak_i > peak.thr_i and peak.peak_f > peak.thr_f
                if last >= 0 and peak.moment - peaks[last].moment < config[1] / 5 and 2 * peak.slope < peaks[last].slope
                    peak.category = "twave"
                    update = "noise"
                else
                    peak.category = "qrs"
                    update = "signal"
                    register = true
            else
                peak.category = "noise"
                update = "noise"
            peaks[index] = peak
            if update != ""
                .update_levels(index, update)
            if register
                .register_peak(index)
        .search_back(count)

class Beat(int number, int sample, int rr, int hr, int width, string label, string method)
    annotation := -1
    offset := 0

Beat[] beat_list(int[] registered, detector.Peak[] peaks, int[] band, int premature_percent, int width_limit)
    Beat[] beats := []
    for peak_index := registered[]
        peak := peaks[peak_index]
        number := int(#beats) + 1
        sample := if peak.position < 21 then 0 else peak.position - 21
        rr := if number > 1 then 5 * (sample - beats[-1].sample) else -1
        heart_rate := if rr > 0 then report.rdiv(6000000, rr) else -1
        width := detector.width(band, peak.position)
        label := "N"
        if number >= 10
            preceding := 0
            for: number - 8 <= previous < number
                preceding += beats[previous - 1].rr
            if 800 * rr < premature_percent * preceding
                label = if width > width_limit then "V" else "A"
        beats = beats.append(Beat(number, sample, rr, heart_rate, width, label, if peak.category == "qrs" then "threshold" else "searchback"))
    return beats

void match_annotations(Beat[] &beats, io.Annotation[] &refs, int tolerance)
    for: index < int(#beats)
        beat := beats[index]
        chosen := -1
        distance := 0
        for: reference < int(#refs)
            delta := absolute(refs[reference].sample - beat.sample)
            if refs[reference].beat < 0 and delta <= tolerance and (chosen < 0 or delta < distance)
                chosen = reference
                distance = delta
        if chosen >= 0
            beat.annotation = chosen
            beat.offset = 5 * (beat.sample - refs[chosen].sample)
            refs[chosen].beat = index
            beats[index] = beat

class Segment(int start, int stop)
    refs := 0
    tp := 0
    fp := 0
    false_negative := 0
    noise := 0
    beats := 0
    int[] rr := []

Segment[] segments(Beat[] beats, io.Annotation[] refs, detector.Peak[] peaks, int count, int segment_ms)
    width := segment_ms / 5
    Segment[] result := []
    for: start < count step width
        stop := if start + width < count then start + width else count
        segment := Segment(5 * start, 5 * stop)
        for reference := refs[]
            if reference.sample >= start and reference.sample < stop
                segment.refs += 1
                if reference.beat >= 0
                    segment.tp += 1
                else
                    segment.false_negative += 1
        for beat := beats[]
            if beat.sample >= start and beat.sample < stop
                segment.beats += 1
                if beat.annotation < 0
                    segment.fp += 1
                if beat.rr >= 0
                    segment.rr = segment.rr.append(beat.rr)
        for peak := peaks[]
            if peak.moment >= start and peak.moment < stop and peak.category == "noise"
                segment.noise += 1
        result = result.append(segment)
    return result

string[] beat_csv(Beat[] beats, io.Annotation[] refs)
    result := ["beat,sample,time_ms,rr_ms,hr_bpm,width_ms,label,method,ref_sample,ref_label"]
    for beat := beats[]
        ref_sample := if beat.annotation < 0 then "-" else "{refs[beat.annotation].sample}"
        ref_label := if beat.annotation < 0 then "-" else refs[beat.annotation].label
        heart_rate := if beat.hr < 0 then "-" else report.two(beat.hr)
        fields := ["{beat.number}", "{beat.sample}", "{5 * beat.sample}", report.missing(beat.rr), heart_rate, "{beat.width}", beat.label, beat.method, ref_sample, ref_label]
        result = result.append(fields.join(","))
    return result

string[] peak_csv(detector.Peak[] peaks)
    result := ["peak,sample,r_sample,peak_i,peak_f,slope,thr_i,thr_f,class"]
    for: index < int(#peaks)
        peak := peaks[index]
        result = result.append("{index + 1},{peak.moment},{peak.position},{peak.peak_i},{peak.peak_f},{peak.slope},{peak.thr_i},{peak.thr_f},{peak.category}")
    return result

class OrderedLine(int sample, int priority, string text)

string[] ordered_lines(OrderedLine[] records)
    OrderedLine[] ordered := []
    for record := records[]
        position := int(#ordered)
        ordered = ordered.append(record)
        while position > 0 and (record.sample < ordered[position - 1].sample or (record.sample == ordered[position - 1].sample and record.priority < ordered[position - 1].priority))
            ordered[position] = ordered[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        ordered[position] = record
    return [for record := ordered[] then record.text]

string[] matching_csv(Beat[] beats, io.Annotation[] refs)
    OrderedLine[] records := []
    for reference := refs[]
        line := "{reference.sample},{reference.label},-,-,-,-,FN,-"
        if reference.beat >= 0
            beat := beats[reference.beat]
            line = "{reference.sample},{reference.label},{beat.number},{beat.sample},{beat.label},{beat.offset},TP," + yes(reference.label == beat.label)
        records = records.append(OrderedLine(reference.sample, 0, line))
    for beat := beats[]
        if beat.annotation < 0
            records = records.append(OrderedLine(beat.sample, 1, "-,-,{beat.number},{beat.sample},{beat.label},-,FP,-"))
    return ["ref_sample,ref_label,beat,beat_sample,beat_label,offset_ms,status,agree"].concat(ordered_lines(records))

string[] excerpt(int[] samples, int[][] signals, int count)
    result := ["sample,ecg,lowpass,bandpass,derivative,squared,integrated"]
    for: index < count
        result = result.append("{index},{samples[index]},{signals[0][index]},{signals[1][index]},{signals[2][index]},{signals[3][index]},{signals[4][index]}")
    return result

string[] label_names()
    return ["N", "V", "A"]

int label_index(string label)
    return if label == "N" then 0 elif label == "V" then 1 else 2

string level_line(string prefix, int[] levels)
    return "{prefix} spki={levels[0]} npki={levels[1]} spkf={levels[2]} npkf={levels[3]}"

string[] performance(Beat[] beats, io.Annotation[] refs, detector.Peak[] peaks, Detection detection, Params params, Segment[] parts, int count)
    classes := ["qrs", "searchback", "twave", "refractory", "noise"]
    category_counts := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    types := [0, 0, 0]
    detected := [0, 0, 0]
    int[][] confusion := array(3, fill = array(4, fill = 0))
    extras := [0, 0, 0]
    method_total := [0, 0]
    method_tp := [0, 0]
    int[] offsets := []
    OrderedLine[] errors := []
    tp := 0
    fp := 0
    for peak := peaks[]
        for: index < 5
            if classes[index] == peak.category
                category_counts[index] += 1
    for reference := refs[]
        category := label_index(reference.label)
        types[category] += 1
        if reference.beat >= 0
            tp += 1
            confusion[category][label_index(beats[reference.beat].label)] += 1
        else
            confusion[category][3] += 1
            errors = errors.append(OrderedLine(reference.sample, 1, "false_negative sample={reference.sample} time_ms={5 * reference.sample} label={reference.label}"))
    for beat := beats[]
        category := label_index(beat.label)
        method := if beat.method == "threshold" then 0 else 1
        detected[category] += 1
        method_total[method] += 1
        if beat.annotation >= 0
            method_tp[method] += 1
            offsets = offsets.append(beat.offset)
        else
            fp += 1
            extras[category] += 1
            errors = errors.append(OrderedLine(beat.sample, 0, "false_positive beat={beat.number} sample={beat.sample} time_ms={5 * beat.sample} label={beat.label}"))
    false_negative := int(#refs) - tp
    string[] category_items := []
    for: index < 5
        category_items = category_items.append(classes[index] + "={category_counts[index]}")
    current := thresholds(detection.levels)
    result := [
        "DETECTOR",
        "samples {count}",
        "duration_ms {5 * count}",
        "peaks {#peaks} " + category_items.join(" "),
        level_line("initial_levels", detection.initial),
        level_line("final_levels", detection.levels),
        "final_thresholds thr_i={current[0]} thr_f={current[1]}",
        "final_rr_averages rravg1_ms={5 * detection.ra1} rravg2_ms={5 * detection.ra2}",
        "MATCHING",
        "tolerance_ms {params.match_ms}",
        "references {#refs} N={types[0]} V={types[1]} A={types[2]}",
        "detections {#beats} N={detected[0]} V={detected[1]} A={detected[2]}",
        "true_positives {tp}",
        "false_positives {fp}",
        "false_negatives {false_negative}",
        "sensitivity " + report.ratio(tp, int(#refs)),
        "positive_predictivity " + report.ratio(tp, int(#beats)),
        "detection_error_rate " + report.ratio(fp + false_negative, int(#refs)),
        "by_method threshold={method_tp[0]}/{method_total[0]} searchback={method_tp[1]}/{method_total[1]}",
    ]
    if #offsets == 0
        result = result.append("offset_ms none")
    else
        absolute_sum := 0
        absolute_max := 0
        for offset := offsets[]
            absolute_sum += absolute(offset)
            if absolute(offset) > absolute_max
                absolute_max = absolute(offset)
        result = result.append("offset_ms mean=" + report.two(report.rdiv(100 * hrv.sum_values(offsets), int(#offsets))) + " mean_abs=" + report.two(report.rdiv(100 * absolute_sum, int(#offsets))) + " max_abs={absolute_max}")
    result = result.concat(["CONFUSION", "ref  " + pad("N", 6) + pad("V", 6) + pad("A", 6) + "  miss"])
    names := label_names()
    for: category < 3
        line := names[category] + "    "
        for value := confusion[category][]
            line += pad("{value}", 6)
        result = result.append(line)
    line := "extra"
    for value := extras[]
        line += pad("{value}", 6)
    result = result.append(line)
    for: 1 <= category < 3
        prefix := if category == 1 then "veb" else "sveb"
        result = result.append(prefix + "_sensitivity " + report.ratio(confusion[category][category], types[category]))
        result = result.append(prefix + "_positive_predictivity " + report.ratio(confusion[category][category], detected[category]))
    result = result.append("SEGMENTS segment_ms={params.segment_ms} segments={#parts}")
    for part := parts[]
        result = result.append(pad("{part.start}", 6) + "-" + pad("{part.stop}", 6) + " refs={part.refs} tp={part.tp} fp={part.fp} fn={part.false_negative} noise_peaks={part.noise}")
    return result.append("ERRORS count={#errors}").concat(ordered_lines(errors))

class Variability(int[] rr, int[] nn, int[][] pairs)

Variability variability_inputs(Beat[] beats)
    int[] rr := []
    int[] nn := []
    int[][] pairs := []
    selected := array(#beats, fill = false)
    for: 1 <= index < int(#beats)
        rr = rr.append(beats[index].rr)
        if index >= 2 and beats[index - 1].label == "N" and beats[index].label == "N" and 5 * absolute(beats[index].rr - beats[index - 1].rr) <= beats[index - 1].rr
            nn = nn.append(beats[index].rr)
            selected[index] = true
            if selected[index - 1]
                pairs = pairs.append([beats[index - 1].rr, beats[index].rr])
    return Variability(rr, nn, pairs)

string[] event_lines(Beat[] beats, int pause_ms, int brady_ms, int tachy_ms)
    string[] result := []
    for: 1 <= index < int(#beats)
        beat := beats[index]
        if beat.rr > pause_ms
            result = result.append("pause beats={index}-{index + 1} rr_ms={beat.rr} start_ms={5 * beats[index - 1].sample}")
    kinds := ["bradycardia", "tachycardia"]
    for kind := kinds[]
        int[] indices := []
        for: 1 <= index < int(#beats)
            if (kind == "bradycardia" and beats[index].rr > brady_ms) or (kind == "tachycardia" and beats[index].rr < tachy_ms)
                indices = indices.append(index + 1)
        for span := hrv.ranges(indices)[]
            count := span[1] - span[0] + 1
            if count < 3
                continue
            total := 0
            for: span[0] <= number <= span[1]
                total += beats[number - 1].rr
            mean_hr := report.two(report.rdiv(6000000 * count, total))
            result = result.append("{kind} beats={span[0] - 1}-{span[1]} intervals={count} mean_hr={mean_hr} start_ms={5 * beats[span[0] - 2].sample}")
    int[] ventricular := []
    for beat := beats[]
        if beat.label == "V"
            ventricular = ventricular.append(beat.number)
    for: 2 <= interval <= 3
        int[][] chains := []
        for number := ventricular[]
            last := int(#chains) - 1
            linked := last >= 0 and number == chains[last][-1] + interval
            if linked
                for: chains[last][-1] + 1 <= between < number
                    linked = linked and beats[between - 1].label == "N"
            if linked
                chains[last] = chains[last].append(number)
            else
                chains = chains.append([number])
        for chain := chains[]
            if #chain >= 3
                kind := if interval == 2 then "bigeminy" else "trigeminy"
                result = result.append("{kind} beats={chain[0]}-{chain[-1]} cycles={#chain} start_ms={5 * beats[chain[0] - 1].sample}")
    return result

string[] variability(Beat[] beats, io.Annotation[] refs, Segment[] parts, Params params)
    values := variability_inputs(beats)
    stats := hrv.statistics(values.rr, values.nn, values.pairs)
    result := ["RR", "beats {#beats}", "intervals {#values.rr}", "mean_rr_ms " + report.maybe_two(stats.mean_rr)]
    if #values.rr == 0
        result = result.concat(["min_rr_ms none", "max_rr_ms none", "mean_hr_bpm none"])
    else
        result = result.concat(["min_rr_ms {values.rr[stats.shortest]} beat={stats.shortest + 2}", "max_rr_ms {values.rr[stats.longest]} beat={stats.longest + 2}", "mean_hr_bpm " + report.two(stats.mean_hr)])
    result = result.concat([
        "NN", "intervals {#values.nn}",
        "mean_nn_ms " + report.maybe_two(stats.mean_nn),
        "sdnn_ms " + report.maybe_two(stats.sdnn),
        "differences {#values.pairs}",
        "rmssd_ms " + report.maybe_two(stats.rmssd),
        "sdsd_ms " + report.maybe_two(stats.sdsd),
        "nn50 {stats.nn50}",
        if stats.pnn50 >= 0 then "pnn50 " + report.two(stats.pnn50) + "%" else "pnn50 none",
        "sd1_ms " + report.maybe_two(stats.sd1),
        "sd2_ms " + report.maybe_two(stats.sd2),
        "HISTOGRAM bin_ms=7.8125 bins={#stats.histogram} max={stats.histogram_max}",
    ])
    for bucket := stats.histogram[]
        bar := "#" * nat(bucket[1])
        result = result.append(pad(report.four(78125 * bucket[0]), 10) + " " + pad(report.four(78125 * (bucket[0] + 1)), 10) + " " + pad("{bucket[1]}", 3) + " |" + bar)
    result = result.append(if #values.nn == 0 then "triangular_index none" else "triangular_index " + report.fraction(int(#values.nn), stats.histogram_max) + " " + report.two(stats.triangular_index))
    premature := [for beat := beats[] if beat.label != "N" then beat]
    ventricular := 0
    supraventricular := 0
    for beat := premature[]
        if beat.label == "V"
            ventricular += 1
        else
            supraventricular += 1
    result = result.append("PREMATURE count={#premature} V={ventricular} A={supraventricular}")
    for beat := premature[]
        preceding := 0
        for: beat.number - 8 <= number < beat.number
            preceding += beats[number - 1].rr
        next_rr := if beat.number < int(#beats) then beats[beat.number].rr else -1
        compensation := "-"
        if next_rr >= 0
            total := beat.rr + next_rr
            compensation = if 10 * absolute(4 * total - preceding) <= preceding then "full" elif 4 * total < preceding then "partial" else "long"
        reference := if beat.annotation < 0 then "-" else refs[beat.annotation].label
        mean := report.two(report.rdiv(100 * preceding, 8))
        prematurity := report.two(report.rdiv(80000 * beat.rr, preceding))
        result = result.append("beat={beat.number} sample={beat.sample} label={beat.label} rr_ms={beat.rr} next_rr_ms=" + report.missing(next_rr) + " mean_ms={mean} prematurity={prematurity}% compensation={compensation} width_ms={beat.width} ref={reference}")
    OrderedLine[] runs := []
    premature_labels := ["V", "A"]
    for label := premature_labels[]
        indices := [for beat := premature[] if beat.label == label then beat.number]
        for span := hrv.ranges(indices)[]
            count := span[1] - span[0] + 1
            kind := if count == 1 then "isolated" elif count == 2 then "couplet" else "run"
            runs = runs.append(OrderedLine(span[0], 0, "{label} {kind} beats={span[0]}-{span[1]} length={count} start_ms={5 * beats[span[0] - 1].sample}"))
    result = result.append("RUNS count={#runs}").concat(ordered_lines(runs))
    events := event_lines(beats, params.pause_ms, params.brady_ms, params.tachy_ms)
    result = result.append("EVENTS count={#events}").concat(events)
    result = result.append("TREND segment_ms={params.segment_ms} segments={#parts}")
    for part := parts[]
        prefix := pad("{part.start}", 6) + "-" + pad("{part.stop}", 6) + " beats={part.beats} "
        if #part.rr == 0
            result = result.append(prefix + "mean_hr=none min_hr=none max_hr=none |")
        else
            mean_hr := report.rdiv(6000000 * int(#part.rr), hrv.sum_values(part.rr))
            mean := report.two(mean_hr)
            low := report.two(report.rdiv(6000000, maximum(part.rr)))
            high := report.two(report.rdiv(6000000, minimum(part.rr)))
            bar := "#" * nat(report.rdiv(mean_hr, 500))
            result = result.append(prefix + "mean_hr={mean} min_hr={low} max_hr={high} |" + bar)
    return result

int scale(int value, int top, int bottom, int rows)
    return if top > bottom then report.rdiv((top - value) * (rows - 1), top - bottom) else 0

string axis(int columns, int period, int offset)
    result := "       +"
    for: column < columns
        result += if period > 0 and (column + offset) % period == 0 then "+" else "-"
    return result + "+"

string chart_labels(string heading, int[] columns, string[] values)
    result := pad(heading, 6) + "  "
    for: index < int(#columns)
        gap := 8 + columns[index] - int(#result)
        if gap > 0
            result += " " * nat(gap)
        result += values[index]
    while result.ends_with(" ")
        result = result[0:<int(#result) - 1]
    return result

string[] waveform(int[] upper, int[] lower, int height)
    top := maximum(upper)
    bottom := minimum(lower)
    zero := if bottom <= 0 and top >= 0 then scale(0, top, bottom, height) else -1
    string[] result := []
    for: row < height
        label := if row == 0 then "{top}" elif row == height - 1 then "{bottom}" elif row == zero then "0" else ""
        cells := ""
        for: column < int(#upper)
            cells += if scale(upper[column], top, bottom, height) <= row and row <= scale(lower[column], top, bottom, height) then "#" elif row == zero then "-" else " "
        result = result.append(pad(label, 6) + " |" + cells + "|")
    return result

string[] charts(int[] samples, Beat[] beats, int height, int size)
    rr := [for beat := beats[] if beat.rr >= 0 then beat.rr]
    string[] result := []
    if #rr == 0
        result = ["TACHOGRAM intervals=0", "POINCARE points=0"]
    else
        low := minimum(rr)
        high := maximum(rr)
        result = result.append("TACHOGRAM intervals={#rr} min_ms={low} max_ms={high} rows={height}")
        for: row < height
            label := if row == 0 then "{high}" elif row == height - 1 then "{low}" else ""
            cells := ""
            for value := rr[]
                cells += if scale(value, high, low, height) == row then "*" else " "
            result = result.append(pad(label, 6) + " |" + cells + "|")
        result = result.append(axis(int(#rr), 10, 2))
        int[] columns := []
        string[] labels := []
        beat_labels := ""
        for: 1 <= index < int(#beats)
            if (index + 1) % 10 == 0
                columns = columns.append(index - 1)
                labels = labels.append("{index + 1}")
            beat_labels += beats[index].label
        result = result.append(chart_labels("beat", columns, labels))
        result = result.append(" label |" + beat_labels + "|")
        int[][] grid := array(nat(size), fill = array(nat(size), fill = 0))
        for: index < int(#rr) - 1
            column := if high > low then report.rdiv((rr[index] - low) * (size - 1), high - low) else 0
            row := scale(rr[index + 1], high, low, size)
            grid[row][column] += 1
        result = result.append("POINCARE points={#rr - 1} size={size} min_ms={low} max_ms={high}")
        for: row < size
            label := if row == 0 then "{high}" elif row == size - 1 then "{low}" else ""
            cells := ""
            for count := grid[row][]
                cells += if count == 0 then "." elif count < 10 then "{count}" else "#"
            result = result.append(pad(label, 6) + " |" + cells + "|")
        result = result.append(axis(size, 0, 0))
        text := "        {low}"
        high_text := "{high}"
        gap := 8 + size - int(#high_text) - int(#text)
        result = result.append(text + " " * nat(if gap > 0 then gap else 0) + high_text)
    for label := label_names()[]
        chosen := [for beat := beats[] if beat.label == label and beat.sample >= 60 and beat.sample <= int(#samples) - 100 then beat]
        int[] baselines := []
        for beat := chosen[]
            baseline := 0
            for: -60 <= offset <= -51
                baseline += samples[beat.sample + offset]
            baselines = baselines.append(baseline)
        if #chosen == 0
            result = result.append("TEMPLATE {label} beats=0")
            continue
        int[] averaged := []
        for: -60 <= offset <= 99
            total := 0
            for: index < int(#chosen)
                total += 10 * samples[chosen[index].sample + offset] - baselines[index]
            averaged = averaged.append(report.rdiv(total, 10 * int(#chosen)))
        low := minimum(averaged)
        high := maximum(averaged)
        minimum_offset := -61
        maximum_offset := -61
        for: index < 160
            if averaged[index] == high and maximum_offset < -60
                maximum_offset = index - 60
            if averaged[index] == low and minimum_offset < -60
                minimum_offset = index - 60
        result = result.append("TEMPLATE {label} beats={#chosen} max_uv={high} max_ms={5 * maximum_offset} min_uv={low} min_ms={5 * minimum_offset} rows={height}")
        int[] upper := []
        int[] lower := []
        for: column < 80
            first := averaged[2 * column]
            second := averaged[2 * column + 1]
            upper = upper.append(if first > second then first else second)
            lower = lower.append(if first < second then first else second)
        result = result.concat(waveform(upper, lower, height)).append(axis(80, 10, 0))
        int[] columns := []
        string[] values := []
        for: column < 80 step 10
            columns = columns.append(column)
            values = values.append("{10 * column - 300}")
        result = result.append(chart_labels("ms", columns, values))
    return result

string[] rhythm_strip(int[] samples, Beat[] beats, io.Annotation[] refs, Params params)
    start := params.strip_start_ms / 5
    count := params.strip_ms / 5
    columns := count / 10
    int[] upper := []
    int[] lower := []
    for: column < columns
        low := samples[start + 10 * column]
        high := low
        for: 1 <= offset < 10
            value := samples[start + 10 * column + offset]
            if value < low
                low = value
            if value > high
                high = value
        upper = upper.append(high)
        lower = lower.append(low)
    low := minimum(lower)
    high := maximum(upper)
    result := ["RHYTHM start_ms={params.strip_start_ms} end_ms={params.strip_start_ms + params.strip_ms} columns={columns} rows={params.strip_rows} max_uv={high} min_uv={low}"]
    result = result.concat(waveform(upper, lower, params.strip_rows)).append(axis(columns, 20, 0))
    int[] positions := []
    string[] values := []
    for: column < columns step 20
        positions = positions.append(column)
        values = values.append("{(params.strip_start_ms + 50 * column) / 1000}")
    result = result.append(chart_labels("s", positions, values))
    beat_marks := array(nat(columns), fill = " ")
    ref_marks := beat_marks
    for beat := beats[]
        if beat.sample >= start and beat.sample < start + count
            beat_marks[(beat.sample - start) / 10] = beat.label
    for reference := refs[]
        if reference.sample >= start and reference.sample < start + count
            ref_marks[(reference.sample - start) / 10] = reference.label
    return result.concat([" beats |" + beat_marks.join("") + "|", "  refs |" + ref_marks.join("") + "|"])

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    quotient := numerator / denominator
    return if numerator % denominator < 0 then quotient - 1 else quotient

int rdiv(int numerator, int denominator)
    return floor_div(2 * numerator + denominator, 2 * denominator)

string two(int value)
    magnitude := if value < 0 then -value else value
    whole := magnitude / 100
    decimal := magnitude % 100
    return (if value < 0 then "-" else "") + "{whole}.{decimal:02.}"

string four(int value)
    whole := value / 10000
    decimal := value % 10000
    return "{whole}.{decimal:04.}"

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    first := numerator
    second := denominator
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return "{numerator / first}/{denominator / first}"

string ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return "{numerator}/0 none"
    return "{numerator}/{denominator} reduced=" + fraction(numerator, denominator) + " percent=" + two(rdiv(10000 * numerator, denominator))

string maybe_two(int value)
    return if value < 0 then "none" else two(value)

string missing(int value)
    return if value < 0 then "-" else "{value}"

string[] read_lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

int decimal(string word)
    result := int(word)
    return result

int[] read_ecg()
    int[] result := []
    lines := read_lines("input/ecg.csv")
    for: 1 <= index < int(#lines)
        result = result.append(decimal(lines[index].split(",")[1]))
    return result
